name: Sparkline
summary: Inline micro-chart for a single time series. 24-48 px tall, no axes, no grid, optional last-point dot. Designed to sit next to a Stat or KpiCard ('this is the trend'). Always paired with a numeric value AND a label — sparklines without context are noise.

color.description: Defaults to var(--color-text-accent). Use var(--color-text-error) for downward-trend-bad metrics.

showArea.description: Render a faint area fill under the line.

rules: role='img' + aria-label that includes the value AND the trend ('Revenue trend, up 12% week-over-week').
Sparkline alone is not informative — always pair with the numeric value visibly.

do: Use 24-32 px height for KPI rows; 48 px for table cells.
Render last-point dot when the latest value is the focus.
Use var(--color-text-error) for series where a downward trend means bad (churn-rate down is good!).
dont: Don't render Sparkline without an adjacent numeric value.
Don't paint the line in a non-token color.
Don't add axes / grid / legend — that's Chart kind='line'.
